_note: Primary-source pass on South Korea's 32 unlinked nodes. Main technique: Korea's statistical agency (KOSTAT, now reorganized as the Ministry/National Data and Statistics, mods.go.kr) publishes '통계정보보고서' (Statistical Information Reports) and '정기통계품질진단' (Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis) reports for each official statistic, which explicitly state the international manual/standard each statistic follows and/or the other Korean statistic it draws its sampling frame or source data from; every edge below was minted only after fetching the actual PDF/press release and locating the exact quoted sentence. Yield: 20 verified edges wiring 15 of the 32 unlinked nodes (about 47%). Several additional leads (PPI, Wage Structure Survey, Housing Price Survey, Financial Stability Report/Basel) were checked but not minted because the fetched document either lacked an explicit, unambiguous statement or (for BOK's Basel appendix) could not be retrieved due to a signed-URL/CDN fetch failure; these are recorded in _dropped for follow-up. UPDATE 2026-08-29 (Grok follow-up, raw-verified by the orchestrating session): closed the kr-financial-stability -> bis-basel-framework lead — the signed bok.or.kr download URL that failed the first attempt succeeded on a retry (281,837 bytes, matching).

dependencies.basis: Official KOSTAT-affiliated newsletter (통계의 창, published by the National Statistics Human Resources Development Institute) states, in its feature on the 2025 Agricultural, Forestry and Fishery Census: "농림어업총조사는 국제연합(UN) 식량농업기구(FAO)의 세계농업총조사 권고안에 따라 국제적으로 130여 개 국가가 수행하는 범세계적인 센서스이다." ("The Agricultural, Forestry and Fishery Census is a worldwide census conducted by roughly 130 countries in accordance with the recommendations of the UN Food and Agriculture Organization's World Programme for the Census of Agriculture.") This directly ties Korea's agriculture/fishery census methodology to the FAO WCA framework.

KOSTAT's own classification-standards portal (kssc.kostat.go.kr), in its official history of the Korean Standard Classification of Diseases (KCD) used to compile Korea's cause-of-death and health statistics, states: "세계보건기구(WHO)가 작성한 국제질병분류(ICD) 체계를 근간으로 한국표준질병‧사인(死因)분류(KCD)를 작성하여 왔다" ("[Korea] has compiled the Korean Standard Classification of Diseases (KCD) on the basis of the International Classification of Diseases (ICD) system prepared by the World Health Organization (WHO)"), and specifically for the 3rd revision: "제43차 세계보건총회(1990년)에서 제10차 국제질병분류를 개정하여 회원국에 적용토록 권고함에 따라 이를 기초로 한국표준질병‧사인(死因)분류를 3차 개정하여 1995.1.1.부터 시행하였다" ("Following the WHO's 43rd World Health Assembly (1990) recommendation that member states adopt the 10th revision of the ICD, Korea's 3rd revision of the KCD was based on it and took effect 1995.1.1."). This is the classification underlying Korea's cause-of-death/health statistics.
dependencies.evidence_quote: 세계보건기구(WHO)가 작성한 국제질병분류(ICD) 체계를 근간으로 한국표준질병‧사인(死因)분류(KCD)를 작성하여 왔다

dependencies.basis: Government Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report on Korea's Monetary and Financial Statistics (통화금융통계, 2023) states: "우리나라의 통화금융통계는 IMF의 「통화금융통계 매뉴얼 및 편제 가이드」에 따라 작성되고 있는 것으로 확인되었다." ("Korea's monetary and financial statistics were confirmed to be compiled in accordance with the IMF's 'Monetary and Financial Statistics Manual and Compilation Guide.'") and separately "IMF의 통화금융통계 매뉴얼을 준수하고 있으며" ("[BOK] complies with the IMF's Monetary and Financial Statistics Manual"). This is the exact manual represented by the corpus node imf-mfsmcg-2016.

Government Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report on Korea's Flow of Funds (자금순환표, 2020) states: "자금순환표는 국제기준인 국민계정체계(SNA)에 따라 매분기 동일하게 작성되어... 동 기준의 개정(SNA1953→SNA1968→SNA1993→SNA2008)으로 인해 체계별로는 형태, 부문 분류가 상이" ("The Flow of Funds table is compiled quarterly according to the international standard, the System of National Accounts (SNA)... due to revisions of that standard [SNA1953→SNA1968→SNA1993→SNA2008], the form and sector classifications differ by vintage"), and elsewhere confirms the current vintage: "2014년 : SNA2008에 따른 개편 완료" ("2014: reform based on SNA2008 completed").

Government Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report on Korea's R&D Activity Survey (연구개발활동조사, 2015) states: "연구개발활동조사는 연구개발활동 현황에 대한 국가 간 비교가 작성 목적의 한 부분이기 때문에 통계의 개념 및 작성방법, 조사기준 등을 OECD의 '연구개발 조사를 위한 표준지침(Frascati Manual)'에 기초하여 설계하고 있다." ("Because international comparability is part of the survey's purpose, the concepts, compilation methods and survey standards of the R&D Activity Survey are designed based on the OECD's 'Standard Guideline for R&D Surveys (Frascati Manual).'")

Government Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report on Korea's Input-Output Tables (산업연관표, 2019) states: "산업연관표는 국민계정 편제를 위한 국제기준인 2008 SNA(System of National Accounts)와 동일한 기준에 따라 작성되며" ("The Input-Output Tables are compiled according to the same standard as 2008 SNA (System of National Accounts), the international standard for compiling national accounts.")
dependencies.evidence_quote: 산업연관표는 국민계정 편제를 위한 국제기준인 2008 SNA(System of National Accounts)와 동일한 기준에 따라 작성되며

dependencies.basis: Government Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report on Korea's External Debt and External Claims statistics (대외채무및대외채권, 2019) states: "대외채무및대외채권 통계에서 사용하는 용어 및 개념은 국제기준인 IMF의 「국제수지매뉴얼 제6판」(BPM6: Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, 6th Edition)... 을 따름" ("The terms and concepts used in the External Debt and External Claims statistics follow the international standard, the IMF's Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, 6th Edition (BPM6)..."); also "2014년 5월 IMF에서 권고한 새로운 국제기준(BPM6)에 따라 통계를 개편" ("In May 2014 the statistics were restructured per the new international standard (BPM6) recommended by the IMF").

The same Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report on External Debt and External Claims states: "IMF의 특별통계공표기준(SDDS: Special Data Dissemination Standard) 회원국이 국제기준(BPM, EDS)에 따라 대외채무 통계를 작성하고 있으며... http://dsbb.imf.org > SDDS > Data > External debt" ("Member countries of the IMF's Special Data Dissemination Standard (SDDS) compile external debt statistics per international standards (BPM, EDS)... [Korea's data is listed at] the IMF SDDS dissemination bulletin board"), directly citing Korea's SDDS subscription as the dissemination framework for this statistic.
dependencies.evidence_quote: IMF의 특별통계공표기준(SDDS: Special Data Dissemination Standard) 회원국이 국제기준(BPM, EDS)에 따라 대외채무 통계를 작성하고 있으며... http://dsbb.imf.org > SDDS > Data > External debt

dependencies.basis: Government Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report on Korea's Trade Statistics (무역통계, Korea Customs Service, 2018) states: "무역통계는 수출입 신고 업무처리 절차를 기초로 수집한 자료를 품목분류번호(HS Code), 관세청분류체계(성질별·신성질별), 국가별, 세관별 등 여러가지 기준에 따라... 집계" and "'92년 이후 HS 8단위 수준까지 통계를 작성하고 있으며" ("Trade statistics classify data collected via customs declarations by item classification number (HS Code)... and since 1992 have compiled statistics down to the HS 8-digit level").

Government Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report on the Bank of Korea's Financial Statement Analysis (기업경영분석, 2022) states, in the section on standard classification usage: "업종별 분류체계는... 통계청의 「제10차 한국표준산업분류」를 사용" ("The industry classification system uses the 10th Korean Standard Industrial Classification issued by Statistics Korea"), and: "제10차 한국표준산업분류는 국제표준산업분류 기준을 반영하고 있어 국제기준에 부합" ("The 10th Korean Standard Industrial Classification reflects the International Standard Industrial Classification standard, and thus conforms to international standards.")

Government Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report on the Domestic Construction Order Trend Survey (국내건설수주동향조사, 2019) lists its main uses: "통계청에서 발표하는 건설경기동향조사(수주, 기성), 지역GDP(GRDP)에 활용" ("Used in Statistics Korea's Construction Business Trend Survey [orders, completions] and in Regional GDP (GRDP)"), i.e. Korea's regional accounts (GRDP) draw on this construction survey's data.

The same Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report on the Domestic Construction Order Trend Survey states, in the same list of main uses: "한국은행에서 발표하는 건설투자, GDP 등 관련 지표에 활용" ("Used in the Bank of Korea's published construction-investment, GDP and related indicators"), i.e. BOK's national accounts (construction investment component of GDP) use this survey's data.

Government Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report on the Service Industry Survey (서비스업동향조사, 2021) states, describing the sampling frame for the online-shopping/mail-order component: "전국사업체조사 결과를 표본추출틀로 이용하여 추출" ("[the sample is] extracted using the National Business Survey (전국사업체조사) results as the sampling frame"), and more broadly, for other components: "○ 표본추출틀로 사용되는 자료의 출처... 통계명: 년 기준 경제총조사" tying the survey's population to the Economic Census / National Business Survey system.

The same Service Industry Survey quality report states, describing the Korean Standard Industrial Classification it applies: "통계법에 의거하여 통계자료의 정확성 및 국가 간의 비교성을 확보하기 위하여 유엔에서 권고하고 있는 국제표준산업분류를 기초로 작성한 통계목적분류임" ("Pursuant to the Statistics Act, and to ensure accuracy and international comparability, [KSIC] is a statistical-purpose classification prepared on the basis of the International Standard Industrial Classification recommended by the United Nations.")

Government Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report on the Survey of Business Activities (기업활동조사) states, defining its survey population and sampling frame: "전국사업체조사 결과로 구성된 기업모집단" ("the enterprise population is constructed from the results of the National Business Survey") and "표본추출틀로 사용되는 자료의 출처 및 주기: 통계명 전국사업체조사를 기초로 구성된 기업체 모집단" ("source of the sampling-frame data: the enterprise population built on the basis of the National Business Survey").

The same Survey of Business Activities quality report states, describing its industry classification: "통계법에 의거하여 통계자료의 정확성 및 국가 간의 비교성을 확보하기 위하여 유엔에서 권고하고 있는 국제표준산업분류를 기초로 작성한 통계목적분류임" ("Pursuant to the Statistics Act, and to secure accuracy and international comparability, [the Korean Standard Industrial Classification applied to this survey] is prepared on the basis of the International Standard Industrial Classification recommended by the United Nations.")

Government Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report on the Small Merchant/Small Business Survey (소상공인실태조사, 2019, KOSTAT) states: "표본추출틀은 전사체 전국사업체조사(통계청, 2018년 기준)자료를 사용하며" ("The sampling frame uses the complete National Business Survey (Statistics Korea, 2018 base year) data") and "표본추출틀은 매년 통계청에서 구축 및 갱신, 전국사업체조사 연간통계로 매년 현장조사" ("The sampling frame is built and updated annually by Statistics Korea from the National Business Survey's annual field enumeration").

The official 2025 edition of '북한의 주요통계지표' (Statistical Indicators of North Korea), published by Korea's national statistics agency, sources its comparative population figures: "출처: (북) 국가데이터처 「북한인구추계('23.8월)」, (남) 국가데이터처 「장래인구추계('23.12월)」" ("Source: [North] National Data and Statistics Agency's 'North Korea Population Projections' (Aug 2023); [South] the same agency's 'Population Projections' (Dec 2023)"), directly citing KOSTAT's Population Projections (장래인구추계, kr-population-projections) as the source for the South Korean figures presented in this compilation.

The same 2025 '북한의 주요통계지표' publication sources its North Korea GDP/economic-growth figures to the Bank of Korea: "출처: 한국은행 ... 주: 2020년 기준년 자료, UN의 국민계정체계(SNA: System of National Accounts)를 적용하여 추정. 북한 경제성장률은 UN의 국민계정체계(SNA)를 적용하여 추정" ("Source: Bank of Korea ... Note: 2020 base-year data, estimated by applying the UN System of National Accounts (SNA). North Korea's economic growth rate is estimated by applying the UN SNA framework"), i.e. the North Korea GDP/growth data in this compilation comes directly from BOK's national-accounts estimation work.

The official press release for '기업특성별 무역통계' (Trade Statistics by Enterprise Characteristics) states: "본 통계는 통계청의 기업통계 자료와 관세청의 무역통계 자료를 연계하여 기업규모별, 산업별, 종사자규모별 등 상세 무역 현황을 파악하기 위한 것입니다." ("This statistic links Statistics Korea's enterprise data with the Korea Customs Service's Trade Statistics data to capture detailed trade conditions by enterprise size, industry, and employment size.") and notes it differs slightly from "관세청 무역통계" (kr-trade-statistics) only due to specific exclusions, confirming it is calculated from that base trade dataset.

UPDATE 2026-08-29 (Grok follow-up, raw-verified by the orchestrating session — the same signed bok.or.kr fileDown.do URL that failed for the prior agent succeeded on retry: 281,837 bytes, byte-identical to Grok's reported size). BOK's own Financial Stability Report (June 2024), appendix "참고 7. 주요국의 바젤Ⅲ 최종안 도입 현황 및 시사점" (Reference 7: Status and Implications of Major Countries' Basel III Final Package Adoption), states: "바젤은행감독위원회(BCBS)가 2017년 12월 발표한 바젤Ⅲ 최종안(잔여규제 개혁안)의 이행시기(2023년 1월)가 지난 가운데 미국, 유럽연합 등 주요국의 바젤Ⅲ 도입 작업이 진행 중이다. 우리나라를 포함한 일부 회원국은 이미 바젤Ⅲ 최종안을 도입･시행 중이나..." ("...Korea, among other member states, has already adopted and is implementing the Basel III final package...") and "2023년 11월 기준 BCBS 회원국(27개) 중 캐나다, 중국, 인도네시아, 일본, 한국, 사우디아라비아 등 6개국이 바젤Ⅲ 최종안 도입을 완료하였다" ("as of Nov 2023, 6 of 27 BCBS members — including Korea — have completed Basel III final-package adoption"). This is BOK's own Financial Stability Report describing Korea's completed Basel III implementation as the basis for the bank-resilience chapter's assessment. REPOINTED 2026-09-04 (Thomas ruling) from bis-basel-framework to basel-iii: BOK names 바젤Ⅲ throughout the appendix and never names the consolidated Basel Framework. Note for the grader: this edge does NOT reach A on the repoint alone, because namesTarget tokenises 바젤Ⅲ as the single token 바젤iii (U+2162 decomposes to III under NFKD) and both the title-run rule and the single-token CJK rule miss it — the latter reads only the English title and its character class excludes Hangul. Recorded in the round note as a measured proposal, not fixed here.

_dropped.why: Fetched the 2019 Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report for 고용형태별근로실태조사 (Survey on Labor Conditions by Employment Type, the modern successor to the old Wage Structure Survey). Its sampling frame is drawn from a different, non-corpus survey (사업체노동실태현황조사), and the only international references found were generic comparisons to Japan's wage-structure survey and to ILO/OECD statistics ('국외통계로는 일본의 임금구조기본통계조사, ILO나 OECD에서...') rather than an explicit statement that its own methodology/data depends on a specific corpus node. Did not mint given no unambiguous quote.

Fetched the 2022 Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report for 생산자물가조사 (Producer Price Survey). It confirms PPI is classified by the Korean Standard Industrial Classification (한국표준산업분류) and its Input-Output-table-based weights, but does NOT restate the 'KSIC is based on ISIC' boilerplate found in the Financial Statement Analysis/Service Industry Survey/Survey of Business Activities reports. The only explicit IMF-manual reference in the document ('IMF의 XMPI 매뉴얼을 참고') is under the Export/Import Price Index section, not the PPI section itself, so the link would be inferential rather than directly evidenced. Dropped rather than forced.

Fetched the 2020 Regular Statistical Quality Diagnosis report for 전국주택가격동향조사 (National Housing Price Trend Survey, ~100 pages). Found only generic language about applying 'domestic or international standards' for terminology and no explicit statement tying its methodology or source data to CPI, SNA, or any other specific corpus node. No usable quote found within the time budget.

The Trade-by-Enterprise-Characteristics press release names the linked business-side data source as '기업통계(기업생멸행정통계 및 기업통계등록부)' (enterprise statistics: business-demography administrative statistics and the Business Register), not literally the '전국사업체조사' (National Business Survey) that is the corpus node's exact title. These are related but distinct KOSTAT products; equating them would overstate the evidence, so only the unambiguous kr-trade-statistics dependency was minted for this node.

The 2025 북한의 주요통계지표 publication states North Korea's GDP/growth is estimated by BOK 'UN의 국민계정체계(SNA: System of National Accounts)를 적용하여' but never names a specific SNA vintage (1993 vs 2008). Rather than guess which SNA-edition node to attach, only the more specific and unambiguous kr-national-accounts-bok (BOK as the cited source) edge was minted.
